title: Order of battle
source: the loaders read out of the game: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-oob.md, CLASSES.md (the production queue) and the LoadKey entries of ghidra/project.json

military_construction.desc: a unit in the production queue

unit_deployment.desc: a built unit waiting in the deployment pool; one unit per block

location.desc: province id the formation sits in. A formation at the top of the file without one is read in full and then silently thrown away

name.desc: its name; leave it off and the game names the formation

id.desc: fixes its unit id rather than letting the game mint one; best left out

leader.desc: id of the commander, from history/leaders/; given to the unit whoever he is - of any country, rank or arm

is_reserve.desc: yes makes it a reserve formation

is_prioritized.desc: yes gives it priority for reinforcement and upgrades

can_upgrade.desc: whether its brigades may be upgraded

expeditionary_owner.desc: country it is on loan from, for expeditionary forces

movement_progress.desc: how far along its move it starts
